title: Cordless Electric Chainsaws Recalled Due to Injury Hazard; Distributed by Hongkong Sun Rise Trading
summary: The chain brake guard in the cordless electric chainsaw can fail and allow the chainsaw to continue operating, posing an injury hazard to users. Units: 48,100 in the U.S. (In addition, 2,100 were sold in Canada).

title: Hunter Douglas Recalls Privacy Sheer Blinds Due to Strangulation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The cord restraints on the combination wand/cord of the sheer blinds can break, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 550 in the U.S. (In addition, 60 were sold in Canada).

title: Infant Bodysuits Recalled Due to Choking Hazard; Made by Alstyle
summary: The snaps at the crotch can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 194,500 (In addition, about 103,100 were sold in Canada).

title: John Deere Recalls ZTrak Riding Mowers Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The mower's blades can continue to rotate under power when the operator leaves the seat, posing a laceration risk to the user or bystander. Units: About 3,700 (In addition, 18 were sold in Canada).

title: Rural King Recalls Electric Blankets and Throws Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The blankets' and throws' electric cord can overheat and catch on fire, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 9,600.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The fork on the bicycle can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 5,550 in the U.S. (In addition, about 390 were sold in Canada and 260 in Mexico.).

title: ISO Beauty Recalls Hair Dryers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The cord can become brittle near the base of the dryer, posing burn hazards. Units: About 73,000 (In addition, about 1,000 units were sold in Canada).

title: Tea Collection Recalls Children's Rompers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps near the collar can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,800 (In addition, 140 were sold in Canada).

title: West Elm Recalls Glass Tables Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The tempered glass top can shatter unexpectedly, posing a laceration and injury hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 5,400.

title: Fujitsu Recalls Battery Packs for Fujitsu Notebook Computers and Workstations Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 5,800 in the U.S. and 606 in Canada.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Residential Zero Turn Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An incorrect routing of the fuel line can cause it to wear and leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,100.

title: Poppin Recalls Pitch Rolling Chairs Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The seat plate can break and detach from the seat base, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,800.

title: Kohler Recalls Gasoline Engines Due to Risk of Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The engines have a faulty fuel cap, which can allow over-pressurization in the fuel tank, posing a risk of a fuel leak and fire hazard. Units: About 24,000.

title: Lenovo Recalls ThinkPad Laptops Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An unfastened screw can damage the battery causing ovearheating, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 78,000 (In addition, about 5,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Tiffany & Co. Recalls Crystal Mugs Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The mugs can crack or break when used with or exposed to hot liquids, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 3,300.

title: B & P Lamp Supply Recalls Lamp Sockets Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lamp socket screw does not fasten tightly which can result in arcing or overheating, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: PL Sleep Children's Sleepwear Recalled by Lemur Group Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's nightgowns fail to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,100 (In addition, about 380 were sold in Canada).

title: Allen Sports Recalls Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bike's frame can break during use causing the bicycle to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 150.

title: Monster Moto Recalls Mini Bikes Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank venting system can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,800.

title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The brake cables on the golf cars and PTVs can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 161,000.

title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Bleeding Drip Taper Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candles' high flame can ignite the surface of the wax, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,400.

title: Outdoor Gas Fire Pits Recalled Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot; Made by Yayi
summary: The bowl base of the fire pits lacks a heat shield to protect consumers from burns while turning off the propane tank after use, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 58,000.

title: NEMO Equipment Recalls Stargaze Recliner Chairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at REI
summary: The straps on the chair seats can fail, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 15,500.

title: Whirlpool Recalls KitchenAid Electric Kettles Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The handle can loosen and separate from the kettle, causing hot contents to spill, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 40,200 (In addition, 47,300 units were sold in Canada and 1,600 in Mexico).
